title: CardInfo
description: Canonical structured record for a sports card extracted by either engine (Claude API or on-device). Inputs are BOTH sides of the card (front + back). Single source of truth; Pydantic and Kotlin types are generated from this file. Extraction hint: year, brand, set and subset are most often printed at the bottom of the card front, and on the label if graded. NOTE: when card_type is 'graded', the 'graded' object should be present (may contain nulls if unreadable).

card_type.description: Whether the card is professionally graded/slabbed or raw (loose).

sport.description: Sport the card belongs to (football = American football).

year.description: Card year or season, e.g. '2003' or '2003-04'. Often printed at the bottom of the card and on the graded label.

brand.description: Card brand/maker (Topps, Panini, Upper Deck, Bowman, Fleer, ...), normalized. Often printed at the bottom of the card and on the graded label.

set.description: Product/set name, normalized. Often printed at the bottom of the card and on the graded label.

subset.description: Insert/subset name, if any. Often printed at the bottom of the card and on the graded label.

card_number.description: The card's number WITHIN the set, as printed (e.g. '#250', 'RC-12'). NOT the serial/print-run numbering like 5/30 — that goes in attributes.serial_number/serial_limit.

photo.description: Visual details of the player's picture printed on the card.

memorabilia.description: Embedded memorabilia details (patch/ball/floor/jersey/shoe pieces). There can be more than one piece in a card.

graded.description: Grading details; present when card_type is 'graded'.

per_field_confidence.description: Confidence in [0,1] for individual fields, keyed by field name (dot-paths allowed, e.g. 'autograph.ink_color').

raw_output.description: Raw engine output (OCR text or model JSON) for debugging.

Attributes.title: Attributes
Attributes.description: Card attribute flags and serial-numbering info.

serial_number.description: For a serial-numbered (limited) card such as '07/99', this copy's own number (the 07). Shows which copy this is out of the print run — NOT the card's number within the set.

serial_limit.description: For a serial-numbered (limited) card such as '07/99', the total print run / population (the 99).

serial_matches_jersey_number.description: True when the copy's serial number equals the player's jersey number (e.g. 07/99 for a player wearing #7) — such 'jersey-numbered' copies are rarer/more valuable. Null if unknown.

Photo.title: Photo
Photo.description: Visual details of the player's picture printed on the card.

jersey_colors.description: Colors of the jersey the player is wearing in the card's picture, if visible (e.g. ['red','black','white']).

jersey_number.description: Best guess for the number on the jersey in the card's picture, if visible (as printed, e.g. '23').

jersey_number_candidates.description: If the jersey number is uncertain (partially visible/occluded), all plausible candidates, best first (e.g. ['8','3']). Null/empty when jersey_number is confident or not visible.

present.description: Does the card contain an autograph? Null if unknown.

ink_color.description: Color of the signature ink (e.g. 'black', 'blue', 'gold', 'silver'). Black is the standard; any other color is rarer/more valuable.

MemorabiliaPiece.title: MemorabiliaPiece
MemorabiliaPiece.description: One embedded memorabilia piece. A card can contain several.

type.description: Kind of piece: patch (multi-color jersey patch), jersey (plain jersey swatch), ball, floor, shoe, or other.

is_fabric.description: Is it an actual piece of fabric/material (true) vs a printed/manufactured facsimile (false)? Null if unclear.

colors.description: Distinct colors visible in the piece (e.g. ['wine','white','gold']).

unique_color_count.description: Number of unique colors in the piece (more colors usually = rarer patch).

contains_team_logo_part.description: Does the piece contain part of the team logo? Null if unclear.

contains_player_name_part.description: Does the piece contain part of the player's name (nameplate letters)? Null if unclear.

contains_team_name_part.description: Does the piece contain part of the team name lettering? Null if unclear.

letters_visible.description: Any letters/characters visible in the piece, as read (e.g. 'AME'). Null if none.

Memorabilia.title: Memorabilia
Memorabilia.description: Embedded memorabilia in the card/slab. 'pieces' lists each embedded piece (can be more than one).

present.description: Does the card contain memorabilia? Null if unknown.

GradedInfo.title: GradedInfo
GradedInfo.description: Details read from a graded slab label and/or verified via a cert API.

grading_company.description: Grading company. BGS = Beckett Grading Services.

description.description: The descriptive information line(s) from the graded label (year/brand/set/player/card# as the grader printed them).

label_text.description: Full raw OCR of the label, for reference.

source_images.description: References/hashes of the input image(s) — front and back.
